chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Charity given by hand protects against an evil death, wards off seventy kinds of calamities, and loosens the grip of seventy devils, all of whom urge him not to do it.

key_terms.اَلصَّدَقَةُ: charity given for the sake of Allah
key_terms.بِالْيَدِ: given directly by one’s own hand
key_terms.شَيْطَانًا: a devil that incites a person away from good

ai.seo_question: How does giving charity protect a person according to hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the immense spiritual and worldly benefit of giving charity directly. It describes charity as a means of protection from a bad end, a shield against many forms of affliction, and a way of overcoming satanic discouragement from doing good.
